scope: Source-context review of16 expressions that the conservative literal scanner cannot resolve. No new runtime test was performed for this document.

sites.sourceDomain: MODULES.includes(target) guards the value obtained from adminUi.goodiesModule before setModule. Unknown values cannot select an unregistered module.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: tests/goodies-navigation.test.cjs in admin; source guard review

sites.sourceDomain: x is produced by MODULES.map, so every rendered tab uses an exact registered module.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: admin navigation tests and registered-module comparison

sites.sourceDomain: For Goodies, next is passed through useOpenModule; its20-entry mapping falls back to Overview and always goes to the registered goodies screen. Other services preserve the existing generic workspace.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: admin tests/goodies-navigation.test.cjs covers advertised module mappings and unknown-module fallback

sites.sourceDomain: The generic go(r) wrapper forwards a string. Recognized literal call sites are covered by the main inventory; arbitrary runtime strings are not exhaustively bounded by this wrapper.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: source trace; no general hosted/runtime-input acceptance claim

sites.sourceDomain: The generic tab(p) wrapper forwards a string. Current BottomNav calls provide home,cats,orders,cart, all registered. It has no exhaustive type/runtime allowlist for hypothetical callers.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: source trace and local customer preview navigation

sites.sourceDomain: Both conditional destinations home and orders exist. A successful detail lookup then pushes confirm; a failed lookup keeps a paid order reachable through Orders.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: tests/goodies-group-handlers.test.cjs and tests/goodies-recovery.test.cjs; local handler transport fixtures

sites.sourceDomain: product:,store: and favs: prefixes are resolved to registered product/store/favs routes. Other initialRoute strings pass through; current App/Saved/message/notification callers require their own source trace and do not constitute an arbitrary-input guarantee.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: App.tsx bridge/source review and local preview route receipts; not all external input strings tested

sites.sourceDomain: Post-hydration initialRoute uses the same registered prefix handlers and known current super-app inputs. Generic string fallback is intentionally recorded as not exhaustively input-tested.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: App.tsx bridge/source review and local preview route receipts

sites.sourceDomain: The helper is called only with home,cats,orders,cart in BottomNav; all four are in the customer route registry.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: actual BottomNav source and registered-route comparison

sites.sourceDomain: goodiesBusinessNotificationTarget returns goodiesRequests,goodiesProducts,goodiesOrders,conversation or payouts. payouts opens a panel; all remaining values are registered pages. Business ownership metadata is checked.

Goodies-only businessSearch produces goodiesProducts or goodiesOrders. A mixed-feature business uses the existing shared search_business RPC; its arbitrary returned page strings are not exhaustively hosted-validated.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: tests/goodies-workspace.test.cjs asserts actual Goodies search result destinations

sites.sourceDomain: The R helper is called with goodiesOrders,goodiesStore,goodiesProducts,goodiesReviews,goodiesRequests. All five are registered Business Space pages.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: actual GoodiesToolsCard source and Business Space registry comparison

sites.sourceDomain: The Goodies activation expression selects goodiesTools or feature. Both are registered; inactive feature receives k:goodies.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: actual FeaturesPanel source and Business Space registry comparison

sites.sourceDomain: goodiesBusinessNotificationTarget returns the same finite registered Goodies destinations, with payouts handled as a panel. goodiesNotificationWorkspace limits business switching to the selected or already-owned business.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: notifications.ts and Workspace source; hosted push/reopen behavior NOT VERIFIED

sites.sourceDomain: Fallback feature is registered, but fallback d.page is a payload string from shared notifications. Goodies recognized destinations use the mapper above; arbitrary legacy/mixed-feature page values are not exhaustively established here.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: source trace only; real push payloads/device acceptance NOT VERIFIED

sites.sourceDomain: ProfileSheet open() receives businessInfo,registration,promotions,audit,security,help, all registered pages. Language/features use existing sheet/panel handlers instead.
sites.evidenceAndLimits: actual ProfileSheet source and Business Space registry comparison

limit: Known finite helper inputs resolve to existing pages. Generic string wrappers, external initial routes, legacy/mixed-feature search and notification payloads require hosted acceptance; source review is not proof of every runtime value.
